why: A per-entity, per-language mark for the destination axis. A German alternate name for a Turkish city is evidence that German has its own name for it, which is a PROXY for German-language interest and is never presented as measured volume.
known_limit: GeoNames uses one code "zh" with no script split, so Traditional and Simplified Chinese cannot be told apart in this file and a zh row is treated as evidence for zh-Hant only in combination with the Taiwanese market demand measured separately.
